title: Canonical Macro Snapshot
description: Immutable macro observations selected only from vintages available at an analyst call's event time.

eventTime.description: The analyst-call event time used as the point-in-time eligibility cutoff.

processingTime.description: When the platform reconstructed this snapshot.

observations.description: Exactly one observation per supported series, ordered FED_FUNDS_LOWER, FED_FUNDS_UPPER, CPI_YOY, CORE_CPI_YOY, PPI_YOY, UNEMPLOYMENT_RATE. Missing numeric values remain explicit nulls.

capturedAt.description: When the reconstructed snapshot was persisted as evidence.

utcInstant.description: Canonical UTC instant with at most microsecond precision; finer values are rejected rather than rounded.
